svg.title: Green Angle
Green Angle
svg.desc: Interpretive study after a visually inspected primary museum photograph. Approximate geometry; interpretive screen colours. Observed six-corner peaked band. Open space below the inner angle is transparent; dimensions describe overall bounds, not band thickness. Palette refinement (2026-11-09): specific source-image review of green; interpretive screen colors, not calibrated to original paint.
svg.metadata: Reference: https://www.thebroad.org/art/ellsworth-kelly/green-angle; object B-KELLY-2P93.15; reviewed 2026-10-27; not a facsimile.

svg.title: Violet
Violet
svg.desc: Interpretive SVG study from the actual primary auction photograph. Approximate geometry, interpretive palette; photographic shadows, frame and texture omitted. Palette refinement (2026-11-09): specific source-image review of purple; interpretive screen colors, not calibrated to original paint.

svg.title: Orange Panel
Orange Panel
svg.desc: Interpretive vector after actual visual inspection. Approximate contours and interpretive screen colors. Individual Chicago component actually viewed in the museum public image preview and downloaded through the ordinary browser. Major corner/curve positions transcribed; wall and cast shadow omitted. Overall bounding aspect uses museum dimensions. Individual panels are distinct from the installation group. Palette refinement (2026-11-09): specific source-image review of orange; interpretive screen colors, not calibrated to original paint.
svg.metadata: Reference: https://www.artic.edu/artworks/152759; inspected 2026-10-27; interpretive study, not a facsimile.

Dark Blue Panel
svg.desc: Interpretive SVG study. Approximate geometry and interpretive screen colours. Six-sided shaped canvas; photographic perspective is not fully rectified. Palette refinement (2026-11-09): specific source-image review of blue; interpretive screen colors, not calibrated to original paint.
